Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Branch on `code`; some rules add members such as `minKm` or `maxBytes` to explain the limit.

detail.example: One or more fields are invalid.

requestId.description: Also in the X-Request-Id response header; quote it when reporting a problem

info.description: REST API for Drivon, a personal vehicle companion: vehicles, fuel, maintenance, expenses, analytics, documents, reminders and the Ask My Vehicle assistant. Endpoints outside Authentication need a bearer access token (the internal job uses a shared secret instead), and every error is an RFC 9457 Problem Details body with a stable `code`.

post.description: Saves the document as pending and returns a presigned `upload`. Send the file with that method, URL and headers straight to storage (not to this API, and without the Authorization header), then call `POST .../{documentId}/confirm`. The URL expires after 10 minutes. Resending the same `id` returns the same document with a fresh URL, or with `upload: null` once confirmed. Files: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB.
